title: Preserve existing production application during Flutter rewrite
context: A Flutter rewrite has begun while the repository contains an existing React/Capacitor application.
problem: Prevent migration work from prematurely replacing or damaging existing application functionality.
options_considered: Develop Flutter independently while keeping React/Capacitor intact.
Replace the existing application during early migration work.
decision: Keep the existing production application intact and functional while Flutter is developed independently. Replacement requires separate human approval after readiness and migration evidence.
rationale: The owner explicitly requires preservation during migration; no Flutter parity or release evidence exists in the scaffold.
consequences: Do not modify legacy application implementation as part of PMS.
Flutter milestones must distinguish scaffold, implementation, testing, device verification, and release.
